items.title: A closed subscheme of projective space over a Noetherian UFD all of whose components have codimension one is cut out by a single homogeneous polynomial
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that a closed subscheme of projective space over a Noetherian unique factorisation domain without embedded points and with all components of codimension one is cut out by a single homogeneous polynomial (statement lines 8041-8049). The counted proof is a complete two-stage argument: it first uses the UFD property of the local rings to turn the subscheme into an effective Cartier divisor and the classification of invertible sheaves on projective space to identify its ideal sheaf with a twist, producing a single homogeneous polynomial whose dehomogenizations cut out the divisor on the standard opens; then it computes the homogeneous ideal by clearing denominators on each chart and applies unique factorisation to a pair of coprime coordinate powers to conclude that the polynomial divides every element of the ideal (proof lines 8051-8091). It is H2: both stages are carried out in the counted span, with the cited inputs being standard UFD, divisor and cohomology statements.
